files.name: Module Glass Developer Console 1.1.1
files.notes: Auto Log Collector release. One-tap full Module Glass test enables the real Stable Recovery verbose runtime logger, refreshes tracked Control Center controllers, checks every module image, parses per-module SpringBoard diagnostics, saves .log + .json automatically, and auto-uploads when a Keychain GitHub token is configured.

files.name: Module Glass Developer Console 1.1.0
files.notes: Advanced Module Glass developer console with realistic live Control Center preview, per-module crop/position editor, continuous device apply, Stable Recovery preference bridge, deep diagnostics, Keychain-protected GitHub PAT, and one-tap diagnostic log upload.

files.name: NextLock 1.0.5 Rootless
files.notes: Adds independent Custom Photo Width and Height controls from 20–600pt, so photos and transparent stickers can be resized horizontally and vertically separately.

files.name: NextLock 1.0.5 RootHide
files.notes: Adds independent Custom Photo Width and Height controls from 20–600pt, so photos and transparent stickers can be resized horizontally and vertically separately.

files.name: Module Glass Preview 1.0.0
files.notes: Live companion app for Module Glass Stable Recovery. Provides Control Center preview, Device Live preference/image changes, Darwin reload notifications, and direct Module Glass log viewing.

files.name: Module Glass 1.1.5 Complete RootHide
files.notes: Complete recovery-first Module Glass package. Embeds the validated stable renderer directly, replaces the failed standalone runtime through 1.1.4, and keeps the shared Aura Settings runtime dependency.

files.name: Module Glass 1.1.5 Complete Source
files.notes: Matching source for the complete RootHide package, built from the validated stable Module Glass 1.0.14 renderer source rather than the failed 1.1.4 hardened renderer.

files.name: NextSolution Transfer 1.1.4
files.notes: Transfer app with Files, Photos, and Videos upload pickers, secure GitHub uploads, and verified custom AppIcon.
